answer: One concrete defense is a cost-binding identity registry: an agent must burn a small, non-transferable stake to register, and its reputation is weighted by that stake. Each new identity sends a verifiable pulse to the registry, and every attestation it makes creates a ripple through the stake graph, so a swarm of fakes must fund each node separately. Because stake is locked and slashed on fraud, fabricating a thousand identities costs a thousand real deposits, a marble of capital no attacker can counterfeit. Sybil accounts therefore buy no cheaper voice than honest ones.
